        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",

            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "        G --&gt; E",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "        L --&gt; M",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "    end",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "    end",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "## Validation Flow",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "**Two-stage validation:**",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Client-side: Immediate feedback",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Checked on every request via middleware",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "Two tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",
            "lineNumber": 96
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.230913907289505
    },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/work_email_auth_system_467a2b18.plan.md",
        "range": {

          "endPosition": {

        },
        "contents": "## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (code) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n\n    if (!error) {\n      // Check if user has email identity linked\n      // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n      const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n      const redirectTo = next || (hasEmail ? \"/protected\" : \"/auth/verify-email\");\n      redirect(redirectTo);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to error page if something went wrong\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=Failed to authenticate with Google&#96;);\n}",

        "contents": "await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\n  })\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Middleware check\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n// User has active access, continue...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~40 lines SQL (users, profiles, indexes) |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~25 lines |\n\n| Server actions (auth logic) | Medium | ~60 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Medium | ~50 lines (includes DB queries) |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form + linking | Medium | ~120 lines |\n\n| Pending approval page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n| Access revoked page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~385 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Separation of Concerns\n\n### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)\n\n- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails\n- **Database**: Store profiles and users data (no RLS - Next.js handles access control)\n- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers, no functions\n\n### Next.js (All Business Logic)\n\n- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing\n- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation\n- **Validation**: Domain validation, input sanitization, business rules\n- **Authorization**: Role hierarchy checks, permission enforcement\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                         Next.js                                  │",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\n/**\n * Google OAuth login button component\n * Handles both sign-in and sign-up flows seamlessly\n */\nexport function GoogleLoginButton() {\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleGoogleLogin = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const supabase = createClient();\n\n    try {\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider: \"google\",\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/callback&#96;,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error(\"Google OAuth error:\", error);\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n      // Note: User will be redirected to Google, so we don't reset loading state here\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Unexpected error:\", error);\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Button\n      type=\"button\"\n      onClick={handleGoogleLogin}\n      disabled={isLoading}\n      className=\"w-full\"\n      variant=\"outline\"\n    &gt;\n      {isLoading ? (\n        \"Connecting...\"\n      ) : (\n        &lt;&gt;\n          &lt;svg\n            className=\"mr-2 h-4 w-4\"\n            aria-hidden=\"true\"\n            focusable=\"false\"\n            data-prefix=\"fab\"\n            data-icon=\"google\"\n            role=\"img\"\n            xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"\n            viewBox=\"0 0 488 512\"\n          &gt;\n            &lt;path\n              fill=\"currentColor\"\n              d=\"M488 261.8C488 403.3 391.1 504 248 504 110.8 504 0 393.2 0 256S110.8 8 248 8c66.8 0 123 24.5 166.3 64.9l-67.5 64.9C258.5 52.6 94.3 52.6 94.3 256s164.2 203.4 254.5 203.4c56.5 0 86.9-31.7 98.1-72.5 10.7-38.6 4.1-66.1-3.5-88.3H248v-94.8h240z\"\n            &gt;&lt;/path&gt;\n          &lt;/svg&gt;\n          Continue with Google\n        &lt;/&gt;\n      )}\n    &lt;/Button&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Server-side CZU email domain validation\n-- Purpose: Ensures that email addresses being changed must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\n-- This uses SECURITY DEFINER to create a trigger on auth.users table for true server-side enforcement\n-- The trigger runs at the database level and cannot be bypassed by client-side code\n\n-- Create validation trigger function with SECURITY DEFINER\n-- SECURITY DEFINER allows the function to access auth.users table even when called by regular users\n-- This provides true server-side enforcement at the Supabase database level\ncreate or replace function public.validate_czu_email_domain_trigger()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_email text;\n  v_email_change text;\n  v_domain text;\nbegin\n  -- Only validate on UPDATE (email changes), not INSERT (new user creation)",

        "contents": "---\n# Specify the following for Cursor rules\ndescription: Guidelines for writing Postgres migrations\nalwaysApply: false\n---\n\n# Database: Create migration\n\nYou are a Postgres Expert who loves creating secure database schemas.\n\nThis project uses the migrations provided by the Supabase CLI.\n\n## Creating a migration file\n\nGiven the context of the user's message, create a database migration file inside the folder &#96;supabase/migrations/&#96;.\n\nThe file MUST following this naming convention:\n\nThe file MUST be named in the format &#96;YYYYMMDDHHmmss_short_description.sql&#96; with proper casing for months, minutes, and seconds in UTC time:\n\n1. &#96;YYYY&#96; - Four digits for the year (e.g., &#96;2024&#96;).\n2. &#96;MM&#96; - Two digits for the month (01 to 12).\n3. &#96;DD&#96; - Two digits for the day of the month (01 to 31).\n4. &#96;HH&#96; - Two digits for the hour in 24-hour format (00 to 23).\n5. &#96;mm&#96; - Two digits for the minute (00 to 59).\n6. &#96;ss&#96; - Two digits for the second (00 to 59).\n7.       "codeBlock": {

          "endPosition": {

          }
        },
        "contents": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Users table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)\n-- Note: Synced via Next.js server actions, not database triggers\ncreate table public.users (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  email text not null,\n  name text,\n  picture text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\n-- Role enum for profiles (authorization)\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\n-- Focus: Authentication and authorization only\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  removed_access timestamptz,  -- null = active, set = revoked\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\n-- Indexes for auth queries\ncreate index profiles_user_id_idx on public.profiles(user_id);\ncreate index profiles_work_email_idx on public.profiles(work_email);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Entity Relationships\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────┐       ┌─────────────────┐\n│   auth.users    │       │    profiles     │\n│  (Supabase)     │       │  (Auth only)    │\n├─────────────────┤       ├─────────────────┤\n│ id (uuid)       │◄──┐   │ id (uuid)       │\n│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "- Delegation to business logic services\n- Logging and observability\n\n**Business Logic** (in service layer):\n- Core business rules and validations\n- Domain-specific operations\n- Data transformations and calculations\n- Business workflow orchestration\n- Domain knowledge and expertise\n\n**Example:**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Application Logic (tRPC Procedure)\nexport const createUserProcedure = protectedProcedure\n  .input(createUserSchema)\n  .mutation(async ({ ctx, input }) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      // Application logic: validation, auth, delegation\n      const result = await createUser({\n        userId: ctx.auth.userId,\n        ...input\n      });\n      \n      return { success: true, data: result };\n    } catch (error) {\n      // Application logic: error handling\n      if (error instanceof CustomError) {\n        throw error;\n      }\n      throw new CustomError(\"INTERNAL_ERROR\", \"An unexpected error occurred\");\n    }\n  });\n\n// Business Logic (Service Layer)\nexport const createUser = async (params: CreateUserParams): Promise&lt;User&gt; =&gt; {\n  const { userId, email, name, role } = params;\n  \n  // Business logic: domain rules\n  if (role === 'admin' &amp;&amp; !await hasAdminPrivileges(userId)) {\n    throw new CustomError(\"UNAUTHORIZED\", \"Insufficient privileges for admin role\", 403);\n  }\n  \n  // Business logic: business validations\n  if (await isEmailAlreadyTaken(email)) {\n    throw new CustomError(\"CONFLICT\", \"Email already registered\", 409);\n  }\n  \n  // Business logic: domain operations\n  const user = await userRepo.create({\n    email: email.toLowerCase(),\n    name: name.trim(),\n    role,\n    status: 'pending_verification'\n  });\n  \n  // Business logic: business workflow\n  await sendWelcomeEmail(user);\n  await createDefaultPreferences(user.id);\n  \n  return user;\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### External API Integration\n\n- Isolate external service calls in dedicated modules\n- Implement retry logic with exponential backoff\n- Map provider errors to internal error types\n- Store sensitive data (tokens, keys) securely\n\n## Database &amp; Data Layer\n\n### ORM Best Practices\n\n- Use type-safe ORMs (Drizzle, Prisma, etc.)",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "- Delegation to business logic services",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "- Logging and observability",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "**Business Logic** (in service layer):",
            "lineNumber": 110

          },

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm() {\nconst handleSendOTP = async  {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Validate email format\n      if (!email || !email.includes(\"@\")) {\n        setError(\"Please enter a valid email address\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate CZU domain\n      if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(email.trim())) {\n        setError(\"Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Use updateUser to add email identity to existing authenticated user\n      // This sends a verification link to the email address\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // Note: This adds the email as a secondary identity, not changing the primary email\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser(\n        {\n          email: email.trim(),\n        },\n      );\n\n      if (updateError) {\n        // If email already exists, that's actually fine - it means it might already be linked\n        // or we need to handle it differently\n        if (updateError.message?.includes(\"already registered\")) {\n          setError(\"This email is already registered. Please use a different email or sign in with that email.\");\n        } else {\n          setError(updateError.message || \"Failed to send OTP code\");\n        }\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Move to OTP verification step\n      setStep(\"otp\");\n      savePersistedState({ step: \"otp\", email: email.trim() });\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "template = \"Your code is {{ .Code }}\"\n# Controls the minimum amount of time that must pass before sending another sms otp.\nmax_frequency = \"5s\"\n\n# Use pre-defined map of phone number to OTP for testing.\n# [auth.sms.test_otp]\n# 4152127777 = \"123456\"\n\n# Configure logged in session timeouts.\n# [auth.sessions]\n# Force log out after the specified duration.\n# timebox = \"24h\"\n# Force log out if the user has been inactive longer than the specified duration.\n# inactivity_timeout = \"8h\"\n\n# This hook runs before a new user is created and allows developers to reject the request based on the incoming user object.\n[auth.hook.before_user_created]\nenabled = true\nuri = \"pg-functions://postgres/public/before_user_created_hook\"\n\n# This hook runs before a token is issued and allows you to add additional claims based on the authentication method used.\n# [auth.hook.custom_access_token]\n# enabled = true\n# uri = \"pg-functions://&lt;database&gt;/&lt;schema&gt;/&lt;hook_name&gt;\"\n\n# Configure one of the supported SMS providers: &#96;twilio&#96;, &#96;twilio_verify&#96;, &#96;messagebird&#96;, &#96;textlocal&#96;, &#96;vonage&#96;.\n[auth.sms.twilio]\nenabled = false\naccount_sid = \"\"\nmessage_service_sid = \"\"\n# DO NOT commit your Twilio auth token to git.         "contents": "Got it — here’s your **agent-optimized PRD template in Markdown (&#96;.md&#96;)** so you can reuse it for any product:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;markdown\n# PRD — [Product Name] MVP\n\n## 1. Overview\n[One-paragraph description of the product. Include key functionality, user interactions, and constraints like onboarding or payment.]\n\n---\n\n## 2. System Goals\n- [Goal 1: core outcome]\n- [Goal 2: workflows to automate or improve]\n- [Goal 3: monetization / business value]\n\n---\n\n## 3. Entities &amp; Schemas\n\n### Example: &#96;users&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate table users (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  email text unique not null,\n  phone text unique,\n  created_at timestamptz default now()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Example: &#96;subscriptions&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate table subscriptions (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  user_id uuid references users(id),\n  stripe_customer_id text,\n  stripe_subscription_id text,\n  status text check (status in ('active','canceled','past_due')),\n  created_at timestamptz default now()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\\[Add more entities as needed: &#96;messages&#96;, &#96;tasks&#96;, &#96;reminders&#96;, etc.]\n\n---\n\n## 4. Features\n\n### 4.1 Onboarding &amp; Payment\n\n* **Signup:** \\[Auth provider]\n* **Phone Verification:**\n\n  * Input: &#96;{ phone_number }&#96;\n  * Output: &#96;{ success: true, otp_sent: true }&#96;\n* **Payment:** Stripe/PayPal/etc → subscription sync\n\n### 4.2 Channels / Interfaces\n\n#### Web Chat\n\n* Input: &#96;{ user_id, message }&#96;\n* Output: &#96;{ status: \"stored\", assistant_reply }&#96;\n* Flow:\n\n  1. Store in DB\n  2. Call LLM agent with context\n  3. Save + return assistant reply\n\n#### SMS (Twilio example)\n\n* Input:\n\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;json\n  { \"From\": \"+12025550123\", \"To\": \"+12025550999\", \"Body\": \"Remind me tomorrow at 9am\" }\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n* Output:\n\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;json\n  { \"status\": \"stored\", \"thread_id\": \"thread_123\", \"task_created\": true }\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Email\n\n* Inbound: \\[Webhook flow]\n* Outbound: \\[Gmail API, SMTP, etc.]\n* Input: &#96;{ from, to, subject, body }&#96;\n* Output: &#96;{ status: \"sent\", message_id }&#96;\n\n### 4.3 Assistant Capabilities\n\n* **Calendar**\n\n  * Input: &#96;{ action, title, time, attendees }&#96;",
        "signatures": {},

          {
            "text": "Got it — here’s your **agent-optimized PRD template in Markdown (&#96;.md&#96;)** so you can reuse it for any product:",

          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;markdown",

            "text": "# PRD — [Product Name] MVP",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "## 1. Overview",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "[One-paragraph description of the product. Include key functionality, user interactions, and constraints like onboarding or payment.]",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "## 2. System Goals",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- [Goal 1: core outcome]",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "- [Goal 2: workflows to automate or improve]",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- [Goal 3: monetization / business value]",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "## 3. Entities &amp; Schemas",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "### Example: &#96;users&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "create table users (",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "  email text unique not null,",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "  phone text unique,",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "  created_at timestamptz default now()",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": ");",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "### Example: &#96;subscriptions&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "create table subscriptions (",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "  user_id uuid references users(id),",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "  stripe_customer_id text,",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "  stripe_subscription_id text,",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "  status text check (status in ('active','canceled','past_due')),",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "  created_at timestamptz default now()",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": ");",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "\\[Add more entities as needed: &#96;messages&#96;, &#96;tasks&#96;, &#96;reminders&#96;, etc.]",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "## 4. Features",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4.1 Onboarding &amp; Payment",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "* **Signup:** \\[Auth provider]",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "* **Phone Verification:**",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "  * Input: &#96;{ phone_number }&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "  * Output: &#96;{ success: true, otp_sent: true }&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "* **Payment:** Stripe/PayPal/etc → subscription sync",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4.2 Channels / Interfaces",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Web Chat",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "* Input: &#96;{ user_id, message }&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "* Output: &#96;{ status: \"stored\", assistant_reply }&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "* Flow:",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "  1. Store in DB",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "  2. Call LLM agent with context",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "  3. Save + return assistant reply",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "#### SMS (Twilio example)",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "* Input:",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "  &#96;&#96;&#96;json",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "  { \"From\": \"+12025550123\", \"To\": \"+12025550999\", \"Body\": \"Remind me tomorrow at 9am\" }",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "  &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "* Output:",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "  &#96;&#96;&#96;json",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "  { \"status\": \"stored\", \"thread_id\": \"thread_123\", \"task_created\": true }",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "  &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Email",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "* Inbound: \\[Webhook flow]",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "* Outbound: \\[Gmail API, SMTP, etc.]",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "* Input: &#96;{ from, to, subject, body }&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "* Output: &#96;{ status: \"sent\", message_id }&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4.3 Assistant Capabilities",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "* **Calendar**",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "  * Input: &#96;{ action, title, time, attendees }&#96;",

        "contents": "│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │\n└─────────────────┘       │ work_email      │\n                          │ role (enum)     │\n                          │ removed_access  │\n                          │ removed_access_by│──┐\n                          │ created_at      │  │\n                          │ updated_at      │  │\n                          └─────────────────┘  │\n                                    ▲          │\n                                    └──────────┘ (self-reference)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Verification Logic\n\n- **Unverified**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NULL&#96; → User logged in with Google but hasn't verified work email\n- **Pending Approval**: Work email verified via OTP, but no profile exists with that email\n- **Verified &amp; Active**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NOT NULL AND profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **Access Revoked**: &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NOT NULL&#96;\n\n## Constants\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// lib/constants/auth.ts\nexport const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [\n  'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\n};\n\n// Profile roles (matches database enum)\nexport const PROFILE_ROLES = ['student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin'] as const;\nexport type ProfileRole = typeof PROFILE_ROLES[number];\n\n// Role hierarchy for permission checks\nexport const ROLE_HIERARCHY: Record&lt;ProfileRole, number&gt; = {\n  student: 0,\n  team_leader: 1,\n  coach: 2,\n  admin: 3,\n} as const;\n\nexport const hasMinimumRole = (userRole: ProfileRole, requiredRole: ProfileRole): boolean =&gt; {\n  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] &gt;= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole];\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking",

If disabled, only the new email is required to confirm.\ndouble_confirm_changes = false\n# If enabled, users need to confirm their email address before signing in.\nenable_confirmations = true\n# If enabled, users will need to reauthenticate or have logged in recently to change their password.\nsecure_password_change = false\n# Controls the minimum amount of time that must pass before sending another signup confirmation or password reset email.\nmax_frequency = \"1s\"\n# Number of characters used in the email OTP.\notp_length = 8\n# Number of seconds before the email OTP expires (defaults to 1 hour).\notp_expiry = 3600\n\n# Use a production-ready SMTP server\n# [auth.email.smtp]\n# enabled = true\n# host = \"smtp.sendgrid.net\"\n# port = 587\n# user = \"apikey\"\n# pass = \"env(SENDGRID_API_KEY)\"\n# admin_email = \"admin@email.com\"\n# sender_name = \"Admin\"\n\n# Uncomment to customize email template\n# [auth.email.template.invite]\n# subject = \"You have been invited\"\n# content_path = \"./supabase/templates/invite.html\"\n\n# Custom email template for email change confirmation (PKCE flow)\n[auth.email.template.email_change]\nsubject = \"Tappka - potvrďte svůj CZU email\"\ncontent_path = \"supabase/templates/email_change.html\"\n\n# Uncomment to customize notification email template\n# [auth.email.notification.password_changed]\n# enabled = true\n# subject = \"Your password has been changed\"\n# content_path = \"./templates/password_changed_notification.html\"\n\n[auth.sms]\n# Allow/disallow new user signups via SMS to your project.\nenable_signup = false\n# If enabled, users need to confirm their phone number before signing in.\nenable_confirmations = false\n# Template for sending OTP to users\ntemplate = \"Your code is {{ .Code }}\"\n# Controls the minimum amount of time that must pass before sending another sms otp.\nmax_frequency = \"5s\"\n\n# Use pre-defined map of phone number to OTP for testing.",

## Summary

**Problem identified:**
- An old function `handle_new_google_user()` was trying to access `new.identities`, which doesn't exist on `auth.users` (identities are in a separate `auth.identities` table).
- This caused errors when new users were created.

**Solution applied:**
1. Removed the old trigger `on_auth_user_created_populate_users` that called the broken function.
2. Removed the old function `handle_new_google_user()`.
3. Kept the new function `handle_new_auth_user()` which correctly accesses:
   - `new.email` (from `auth.users.email`)
   - `new.raw_user_meta_data` (for Google OAuth profile data)
4. Kept the new trigger `on_auth_user_created` that calls the correct function.

**Current state:**
- Only one trigger remains on `auth.users`: `on_auth_user_created` → calls `handle_new_auth_user()`
- The function correctly extracts Google OAuth data from `auth.users` columns
- The function will automatically populate `public.users` when new users sign up via Google OAuth

The function should now work correctly. When a new user signs up via Google OAuth, it will automatically create a row in `public.users` with their Google profile information.
